question: The Supreme Court of India came into existence on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26 January 1950.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **26 January 1950 date marks the inauguration of the Supreme Court of India.**
 
• It replaced the Federal Court of India and was established under the Constitution of India.
 
• The Supreme Court is the highest judicial body in the country, and its decisions are binding on all other courts in India.
 
• **The first Chief Justice of India was Hiralal J. Kania, who served from 1950 to 1951.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Chief Justice of India and up to 33 other judges make up the Supreme Court, which has broad authority in the form of original, appellate, and advisory jurisdictions.
 
• According to Article 142 of the Constitution, the court has the inherent authority to issue any order that is thought to be required for the sake of full justice, and the President is obligated to carry it out.
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India was founded on 1 April 1935 to respond to economic troubles after the First World War.**
 
• **15 August 1947 is the date when India gained independence from British rule.**
 
• **2 October 1952 is the date when the first postage stamp was issued in India.**
